2026_03_HOU_IND.headline: Houston’s defensive speed tests Indianapolis’ balance in an AFC South leverage game
2026_03_HOU_IND.paragraph1: Houston’s defense can make this difficult if its front creates long-yardage situations and lets the secondary play aggressively behind the rush. Indianapolis therefore needs Jonathan Taylor and the early-down offense to keep the full playbook available rather than asking the passing game to repeatedly rescue drives. Houston’s offense has its own challenge: sustaining protection long enough to create explosives without giving the Colts extra possessions through sacks or turnovers. Third-down efficiency should carry unusual weight.
2026_03_HOU_IND.model_rationale: Indianapolis is most dangerous when its run game preserves balance, while Houston can seize control by creating long-yardage situations and winning the resulting protection matchups.
